title: E.l.f. Beauty Shatters Wall Street Estimates, Raises 2027 Forecast Amid Record-Breaking Rhode Launch at Sephora Europe
summary: E.l.f. Beauty’s second-quarter net sales surged 51 percent to $520.8 million, fueled by Rhode’s Sephora launch and international expansion.
